channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Armed man arrested at Trump golf course reportedly had first lady's schedule and Secret Service notes
item.description: Jeanine John Taele allegedly possessed Melania Trump's schedule and details on Secret Service personnel among 208 pages of writings in seven notebooks.

item.title: EPA Chief to Newsmax: US Can Win AI Race, Protect Ratepayers
item.description: EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin countered concerns about the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence data centers, saying the U.S. can lead in AI while safeguarding consumers.

item.title: Judge Blocks Ohio Proof-of-Citizenship Law for Voters
item.description: A federal judge temporarily halted Ohio's requirement for residents to show documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote at Bureau of Motor Vehicles offices.

item.title: Lawyer for Fed's Cook Says There Are No Grounds for Dismissal
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook's lawyer provided a detailed rebuttal on Wednesday to the mortgage fraud accusations cited by President Donald Trump in his push to remove her.
